summary: Pong entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Pong

emulation.notes: Use the arcade Pong version in the collection for normal archive capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official modern recreation/emulation of the 1972 arcade game.

primary.version: Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration arcade Pong
primary.why: The original 1972 arcade release and later official conversion/collection routes reflect Pong's well-established arcade origin. Atari 50 provides the cleanest modern official capture route for the arcade game.
primary.how_to_play: Play Pong through Atari 50 on Windows or another current platform, using the arcade version. For hardware-authentic study, compare against cabinet footage/hardware notes, but use Atari 50 for normal capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: The original arcade board used dedicated hardware, so any modern collection is a practical preservation route rather than original circuitry capture.
